lines.en: So, what did you think of the film? The plot was slow, but the cast was great, in my opinion.
lines.pt: E então, o que achou do filme? O enredo foi lento, mas o elenco foi ótimo, na minha opinião.

lines.en: I agree about the cast. The lead actress was brilliant, but the plot had too many holes, and the ending felt rushed.
lines.pt: Concordo sobre o elenco. A atriz principal foi brilhante, mas o enredo tinha buracos demais, e o final pareceu apressado.

lines.en: Exactly. The director clearly wanted to surprise us, but I guessed the twist in the first half hour.
lines.pt: Exato. O diretor claramente queria nos surpreender, mas eu adivinhei a reviravolta na primeira meia hora.

lines.en: Me too! The reviews were so positive that I expected something unforgettable. Critics gave it four stars out of five.
lines.pt: Eu também! As críticas foram tão positivas que esperei algo inesquecível. Os críticos deram quatro estrelas de cinco.

lines.en: Critics often love slow films. I checked the audience rating online yesterday, and it was only six out of ten.
lines.pt: Críticos costumam adorar filmes lentos. Vi a nota do público on-line ontem, e era só seis de dez.

lines.en: That sounds fair. The soundtrack deserves more praise, though. It made the boring scenes bearable.
lines.pt: Parece justo. A trilha sonora merece mais elogios, porém. Ela tornou as cenas chatas suportáveis.

lines.en: True, the music was beautiful. Would you recommend it to our friends, or should we keep quiet about it?
lines.pt: Verdade, a música foi linda. Você recomendaria aos nossos amigos, ou devemos ficar quietos sobre isso?

lines.en: I would recommend it to people who like art films. For others, I would wait for the streaming version.
lines.pt: Eu recomendaria a quem gosta de filmes de arte. Para os outros, eu esperaria a versão de streaming.

lines.en: Good advice. By the way, I read the novel it is based on, and the book is far better than the film.
lines.pt: Bom conselho. A propósito, li o romance em que se baseia, e o livro é muito melhor que o filme.

lines.en: Books usually are. A writer can describe thoughts, whereas a film has to show everything.
lines.pt: Livros costumam ser. Um escritor pode descrever pensamentos, enquanto um filme precisa mostrar tudo.

lines.en: Right. Next week, let us pick a comedy. After a slow drama like this one, I need a good laugh.
lines.pt: Certo. Semana que vem, vamos escolher uma comédia. Depois de um drama lento como este, preciso de uma boa risada.

paragraphs: It is Saturday night outside a cinema in Atlanta. Hal and Max just watched a new drama. The film was long. The street is full of people. Each friend has strong opinions. They start to talk about the film.

“So, what did you think of the film? The plot was slow, but the cast was great, in my opinion.” says Hal. “I agree about the cast. The lead actress was brilliant, but the plot had too many holes, and the ending felt rushed.” says Max. “Exactly. The director clearly wanted to surprise us, but I guessed the twist in the first half hour.” says Hal.

pages.title: Conversa · começo
lines: Hal
So, what did you think of the film? The plot was slow, but the cast was great, in my opinion.
E então, o que achou do filme? O enredo foi lento, mas o elenco foi ótimo, na minha opinião.
You
I agree about the cast. The lead actress was brilliant, but the plot had too many holes, and the ending felt rushed.
Concordo sobre o elenco. A atriz principal foi brilhante, mas o enredo tinha buracos demais, e o final pareceu apressado.
Hal
Exactly. The director clearly wanted to surprise us, but I guessed the twist in the first half hour.
Exato. O diretor claramente queria nos surpreender, mas eu adivinhei a reviravolta na primeira meia hora.
You
Me too! The reviews were so positive that I expected something unforgettable. Critics gave it four stars out of five.
Eu também! As críticas foram tão positivas que esperei algo inesquecível. Os críticos deram quatro estrelas de cinco.
Hal
Critics often love slow films. I checked the audience rating online yesterday, and it was only six out of ten.
Críticos costumam adorar filmes lentos. Vi a nota do público on-line ontem, e era só seis de dez.
You
That sounds fair. The soundtrack deserves more praise, though. It made the boring scenes bearable.
Parece justo. A trilha sonora merece mais elogios, porém. Ela tornou as cenas chatas suportáveis.

lines: Hal
True, the music was beautiful. Would you recommend it to our friends, or should we keep quiet about it?
Verdade, a música foi linda. Você recomendaria aos nossos amigos, ou devemos ficar quietos sobre isso?
You
